tasks.short: Recommend materials using explicit property comparisons and engineering judgement

steps.what: Review new product plans and verify material properties, operating conditions and design objectives
Compare candidate material properties against specified strength, weight, heat, conductivity and cost criteria
Assess comparison limits and make material selection recommendations with supporting evidence and uncertainties

tasks.design: Configure a property comparison in the {OTHER} materials engineering environment using engineer-checked requirements and source values. Keep evidence limits visible in {DOCS}; the engineer interprets trade-offs and recommends a material without treating a passed numerical filter as proof of suitability.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated comparison tables consumed time alongside the harder task of understanding property evidence and trade-offs.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing calculation and filtering functions can rerun explicit comparisons once conditions and units are checked.
tasks.still_hard: Published properties may not represent the intended loading, environment, fabrication route or lifetime.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recognises when apparently comparable numbers describe different material behaviour.
tasks.altitude: Less table preparation leaves requirements interpretation and material recommendation fully with the engineer.

reach.task: Explain how material trade-offs affect the intended product

evidence.claim: A configured comparison of checked material properties is a model-knowledge design; the digest does not establish measured material-selection savings.

assumptions: Boundary is requirements review, property comparison and recommendation, not product qualification or procurement. Prices here are reference candidate costs, not a second full manufacturing cost model.

Product designers supply plans and intended conditions; suppliers and laboratories produce property reports. In fully retained s1 the engineer captures candidate id, source version, property value, unit, test condition, cost basis and comparison threshold, including unresolved gaps.

The engineer produces the comparison specification in s1 before s2 runs. Missing or incomparable values are shown as unknown, not converted into a suitability flag; manual source enquiries and capture remain in s1.
Test native materials comparison functions before custom code. OTHER denotes materials engineering and property-data software.
Existing solver runtime earns no saving. Review and recommendation retain full time, and source maintenance receives explicit upkeep.
unknowns: Which conditions are decisive for the product
research_questions: Can a native comparison preserve units and test-condition differences while reducing repeated table preparation?

already_counted.description: Verify and capture requirements and source property conditions
Interpret trade-offs and accept the recommendation

incremental.description: Maintain property mappings and comparison definitions
Design or laboratory colleagues clarify changed source conditions

approvals.approved_version: Exact material recommendation, product plan version, comparison dataset and stated limitations verified in s3; changes void acceptance

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=75; gross 25 minus 7 focal upkeep gives central net 18. Range covers already-configured comparisons versus modest removal of repeated tables; source interpretation and recommendation keep full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Evaluate technical specifications and product or process economics

steps.what: Establish technical specifications, production assumptions and source costs for the design alternatives
Calculate economic factors for specified quantities, yields, process times and cost scenarios
Evaluate technical and economic trade-offs and explain implications for the design objectives

tasks.design: Configure repeatable cost calculations in {SPREADSHEET} using engineer-checked inputs from {ERP} and technical records in {DOCS}. The engineer evaluates feasibility, uncertainty and trade-offs; the calculation does not choose or approve a design.
tasks.previous_blocker: Design reviews required repeatedly recomputing specified cost scenarios before their implications could be discussed.
tasks.enabler_now: Native calculation templates can apply checked formulas to explicit production assumptions.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain yields, scale effects and technical compromises may dominate the apparent cost difference.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recognises when economic comparisons rest on technically unrealistic assumptions.
tasks.altitude: Calculation preparation may fall, while technical and economic evaluation remains unchanged.

reach.task: Separate source costs from uncertain production assumptions

evidence.claim: Configured calculation templates for checked quantities and costs are a model-knowledge design; no task-specific engineering saving is measured in the digest.

assumptions: Boundary is design-level technical and economic evaluation, not material-property filtering, production planning or design approval. If a specific calculation is reused from another task, a roll-up counts that action once rather than adding both allowances.

Finance and procurement staff maintain source prices and rates; design and production colleagues provide quantities, expected yields and process assumptions. In retained s1 the engineer checks and captures scenario id, quantity, unit, currency, cost date, rate, yield, process time and formula version.
s2 starts only after s1 produces checked inputs and the calculation specification. Missing assumptions return to manual enquiry and capture in s1, with no automatic inference from an absent value.
Test native calculation templates before custom integration. Existing calculation runtime itself earns no labour saving; only repeated manual preparation is touched.
The upkeep allowance covers template and mapping changes; extra finance or production clarification is counted separately.
unknowns: Whether scenario calculations are already automated
Access to current prices and process rates
research_questions: Can native templates reproduce checked cost scenarios while exposing uncertain yields and rates?

already_counted.description: Capture and verify economic assumptions and formula definitions

incremental.description: Maintain calculation templates and source mappings
Finance and production staff clarify changed rates or assumptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=80; gross 20 minus 7 focal upkeep gives central net 13. Range covers existing automated costing versus a small repeatable scenario component; all assumption checking and design evaluation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Solve engineering problems through investigation and validated reasoning

steps.what: Solve engineering problems by investigating material behaviour, testing hypotheses and evaluating potential solutions

tasks.design: Retain problem framing, investigation and solution evaluation with the engineer using {DOCS} and the {OTHER} engineering analysis environment. Existing calculations assist the reasoning without replacing evidence gathering or establishing that an executable model is correct.
tasks.previous_blocker: Engineering problems vary in their physical causes, evidence and consequences.
tasks.enabler_now: Analysis tools support investigation, but no supplied evidence establishes a repeatable labour-saving solution for this broad problem-solving task.
tasks.still_hard: A numerically plausible result may rely on the wrong physical model or boundary conditions.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer identifies the decisive uncertainty and designs a test that can challenge the proposed explanation.
tasks.altitude: Problem-solving responsibility and effort remain unchanged.

reach.task: Check whether material assumptions fit an equipment failure explanation

evidence.claim: Retaining varied engineering problem-solving is a model-knowledge boundary; general code or simulation capabilities do not establish correct solutions or task savings.

assumptions: Boundary ends at a supported solution proposal, not implementation or formal release. Separately counted comparison or costing actions must not be added again if reused here.

Problem owners provide symptoms and existing records; engineers and test staff produce observations during investigation. All focal-role evidence enquiries, analysis specification and interpretation stay within s1 at full time.
No ready root-cause, safe or solved flag is assumed. Missing evidence leads to manual investigation and further testing.
Test native engineering analysis functions before custom tools. OTHER denotes engineering analysis and simulation software.
No new system or capture obligation is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero and existing solver runtime earns no saving.
research_questions: Which observed problem-solving activities are repeatable calculations rather than physical or causal judgement?

already_counted.description: Investigation, hypothesis testing and solution interpretation

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net zero with zero incremental upkeep. No generic saving is assigned to varied engineering reasoning, tests or existing calculation runtime.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan and implement laboratory operations for material and fabrication development

steps.what: Plan laboratory operations and choose investigations against cost, specification and performance objectives
Implement laboratory operations, observe results and refine material and fabrication procedures

tasks.design: Retain experimental planning and implementation with the engineer using controlled plans in {DOCS} and the {OTHER} laboratory analysis environment. The engineer checks the plan before execution, then interprets observations and revises the developing procedures.
tasks.previous_blocker: Laboratory development requires selecting informative experiments under real equipment and material constraints.
tasks.enabler_now: Digital plans can organise work, but the supplied digest does not demonstrate a saving in developing and implementing these laboratory operations.
tasks.still_hard: Unexpected material behaviour can invalidate an initially sensible plan or fabrication method.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer adapts investigations while maintaining the link between evidence, specification and performance.
tasks.altitude: Laboratory development duties and decision rights stay unchanged.

reach.task: Reconcile development experiments with equipment and staffing constraints

evidence.claim: Retaining laboratory planning, physical implementation and experimental interpretation is a model-knowledge boundary; no task-specific saving is established by general validation-record products.

assumptions: Boundary is the engineer's development planning and experimental implementation, not other laboratory staff labour or routine production.

The engineer captures objectives, sample definitions, method, equipment constraints and evaluation criteria in fully retained s1. Test observations are produced during s2, with interpretation and revised procedure capture counted there.
No pre-existing experiment-safe or procedure-qualified flag is assumed. Missing information or conflicting observations require manual review and further tests under existing procedures.
Test native laboratory planning functions before custom code. OTHER denotes laboratory planning, instrument and analysis systems.
No new automation or reporting obligation is introduced, so added upkeep is zero. Existing independent safety permissions remain required and receive no claimed saving.
research_questions: Which planning decisions change after the first representative experiment and why?

already_counted.description: Experimental planning, execution checking and procedure development

approvals.approved_version: Exact laboratory plan, samples, equipment configuration and method checked before each execution in s2; changed conditions or methods require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net zero with no added upkeep. Experimental planning, physical operations and interpretation retain full time; document organisation is not assigned an invented baseline.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Repeated property comparisons and cost scenarios may require less preparation; engineering recommendations and experimental development retain human responsibility.
reach: Work with designers on operating-condition evidence
Work with laboratory colleagues on experimental validity
role.ambitious_version: A materials engineer who makes transparent comparisons and explains where evidence stops supporting a design conclusion.
